items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Roy Barbey had the band... Roy was now in front of the band

ctx.x: Roy Barbey had the band. Whiteman is in the studio, and -- in the control room -- and it's not a good situation for the band, as it as, when we were all happy. We're not making many records. Particularly because they're not selling. Nobody's records are selling at this time.

This was a new low in record sales and it was not a good situation, so when this comes, I could see it. Everybody else could see it and it was -- the Whiteman band had been lucky for the previous two years to have had these -- to have had that moving picture contract, the Old Gold contract and the contract for the theatres. The theatre contract.
